messages:
Maya: Hey design — need a vertical social stack (IG stories, TikTok 9:16) + a speaker one-sheet for next week's webinar. Benchmark graph and a short diagram that shows 'Inference latency vs cost' but simplified for social. Can we get first drafts by Wed EOD? Key assets listed below:
- 3 vertical tiles: hero, stats, CTA
- 1 speaker one-sheet (A4/US Letter + PDF)
- 1 simplified benchmark diagram (png + svg)
Brand notes: use primary palette, no gradients, include logo lockup and partner logos. Link to brand kit: https://redwood.in/brand-kit

Alex: Got it! Can you drop exact copy for each tile? Also sizes:
```
IG Story: 1080x1920
TikTok/Short: 1080x1920
LinkedIn Tall: 1200x1600
```

Sam: I'll own the benchmark chart — will we use the 'latency vs cost' scatter or a bar with normalized units? Prefer bar for social clarity.

Priya: Bar chart please. Copy for stats tile:
- Headline: Meet predictable inference
- Sub: 3x lower token cost at SLO.
- CTA: Register — March 28 webinar

Carla: Design constraints noted. I'll mock 2 variants for hero (photographic + abstract). Need speaker headshot, short bio, and talk title. Maya can you upload assets?

Maya: Uploading headshot + bio now. Bio: "Jordan Rivera — Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference. Talk: 'Serving LLMs: balancing latency, cost, and reliability'." Files: https://files.redwood/inference/webinar/jordan_headshot.jpg

DesignBot: Asset checklist created: hero_v1.psd, hero_v2.psd, stats_tile.png, cta_tile.png, one_sheet_A4.pdf, benchmark_chart.svg. Deadline Wed EOD. /remind @Carla in 2 days

Alex: Quick question on accessibility — text size min 16px on tiles? That's our default.

Carla: Yes, follow WCAG AA — 4.5:1 contrast. Will export @2x and include alt text.

Maya: Thanks team! If we can review early Thu morning that'd be great. :thumbsup:
